findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/candidate-spec-routing.ts:665-670 [HIGH] Protected direct candidates are still sliced by candidateBudget. routeCandidateSpecs assigns related-doc/exact-path/registry-ref/typed-risk/reviewer-evidence score 100, then ranked.slice(0, candidateBudget) drops every protected source beyond the first N. CHK-002 promises that each protected source remains selected even above the frequency threshold; a story with more than eight explicit sources can silently omit required documents. Preserve all protected candidates (or fail/escalate when they exceed the budget) and add an over-budget protected-source test.

packages/main/src/handlers/candidate-spec-routing.ts:183-192 [MEDIUM] Post-probe readiness drift is not classified as promised. If a previously ready launcher reaches the real run and then prints auth/interactive failure to stderr and exits nonzero, defaultHostRunRunner retains no stderr and productionExecutor returns only generic host unavailable exit 1; only silent startup timeout gets a distinct reason. CHK-001 edge:2 explicitly requires a distinct stale-readiness/auth/interactive/no-output diagnostic. Preserve bounded failure diagnostics or map host-run failure evidence, and test injected post-admission auth/interactive exits without real hosts.

packages/main/src/tasks/candidate-spec-routing-smoke.ts:476 CHK-001 mandatory matrix is not covered: the test exercises only unverified/unsupported/auth/timeout, while the intent requires every non-ready state to prove zero spawn (missing row, wrong_launcher, launcherOk=false, progressMode=none/unobservable, silent output/other canonical failures). packages/main/src/tasks/host-run-usage-smoke.ts:2760 tests startup and total timeout directly, but only abort goes through runHostRun and proves cap=1 reacquisition; there is no deterministic first-byte boundary table or output/timeout/close/error/abort ordering matrix. Most importantly packages/main/src/handlers/candidate-spec-routing.ts:270 snapshots readiness once before proposal execution, and no test simulates readiness becoming stale between probe and spawn or verifies the promised distinct stale-readiness/auth/interactive diagnostic. The broad PASS evidence therefore does not substantiate multiple must intents.

packages/main/src/tasks/candidate-spec-routing-smoke.ts:261 does not test the CHK-002 adversarial generic-only flood: it injects five 100-point protectedSources, so the route never faces only lattice/proofbound/core/handlers. With only those over-frequency terms, they are all filtered, ranked is empty, and packages/main/src/core/candidate-spec-routing.ts:634-653 emits zero_candidates escalation, contradicting the mandatory intent that generic-only flood cannot cause ambiguity escalation. Add an actual generic-only corpus/proposal case and align the intended zero-candidate disposition before claiming this intent PASS.

packages/main/src/tasks/candidate-spec-routing-smoke.ts:245-317 covers one above-threshold example, one safe truncation example, only NaN malformed evidence, and renderer strings. It does not cover the required exact DF boundary (at threshold vs just above), duplicate occurrences counting once per document, omitted-score/cutoff missing or inconsistent combinations, cutoff equality, or gate-level shadow/warn/enforce dispositions. The assertion at line 317 compares artifactDigest to itself and cannot detect mode-induced artifact disagreement. Add a table-driven matrix for these stated must cases and exercise the actual binding/gate consumer for each mode.

packages/main/src/handlers/candidate-spec-routing.ts:214-217 — HIGH: currentStoryRoutingInput promotes both filesReadFully and filesTriagedByName from every valid reviewer manifest into reviewer-evidence protectedSources. filesTriagedByName is explicitly the non-selected remainder of the requirements corpus, not reviewer-selected evidence; after one bounded review it can therefore promote nearly the whole corpus at 100 points on the next route, recreating the candidate inflation/full-scan cost this story is meant to remove and crowding out genuinely selected evidence under the 8-item budget. Only positively selected/read evidence should be protected; filename/title triage must remain audit evidence, not direct-candidate authority.
